This is Bright Market's formal escalation on LUM-811 (VAT invoice exports show blank totals).

The totals have been blank since your 5.3.0 upgrade four weeks ago. We were told the fix
would ship in the Sep 20 release; instead your bot announced 5.3.3 fixes and the ticket was
closed while our finance sandbox still showed blank exports. Our chases on the 22nd and 23rd
went unanswered.

Please explain what happened and when this was actually fixed.

Dana Okafor, Finance Lead, Bright Market
Status: In Progress → Resolved
Fixed in 5.3.4. VAT rounding path corrected; exports verified with finance.

claims.text: Nadia Chen identified the root cause as the KESTREL/billing-v2 change in 5.3.0 that moved VAT rounding to integer math, dropping fractional cents and blanking the exported totals; that change went unreviewed.
claims.quote: Follow-up while triaging LUM-811: the KESTREL refactor (billing-v2) moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the totals on export. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: Ravi Menon scheduled a fix for Bright Market's blank VAT export totals in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: We have scheduled a fix for the Sep 20 release. Keeping LUM-811 updated.

claims.text: Ravi Menon promised Bright Market that the VAT export fix would ship in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: For the Bright Market escalation (LUM-811): we will ship the export fix in the Sep 20 release.

claims.text: Ravi Menon told the team Bright Market's LUM-811 export fix would ship in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: For the Bright Market escalation (LUM-811): we will ship the export fix in the Sep 20 release.

claims.text: Ravi Menon told Bright Market by email that a fix was scheduled for the Sep 20 release and that LUM-811 would be kept updated.
claims.quote: We have scheduled a fix for the Sep 20 release. Keeping LUM-811 updated.

claims.text: Priya Nair's email to the client treated the fix as tracked in 5.3.3 and separated the billing-v2 piece, which is consistent with 5.3.3 carrying no VAT rounding correction.
claims.quote: Also tracking in 5.3.3; the billing-v2 piece is separate. Confirm receipt.

claims.text: Priya Nair said the LUM-811 VAT export issue was also being tracked in 5.3.3 with the billing-v2 piece as separate work.
claims.quote: Also tracking in 5.3.3; the billing-v2 piece is separate. Confirm receipt.

claims.text: Nadia Chen told Bright Market that the VAT rounding root cause from 5.3.0 was fixed properly in 5.3.4, shipping the next day.
claims.quote: Correct root found: the VAT rounding change in 5.3.0. Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow.

claims.text: Priya Nair resolved LUM-811 as done on the strength of the 5.3.3 rollout, before any re-check against the client's finance sandbox.
claims.quote: Resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout; exports verified on our side. Flagging as done.

claims.text: The ticket was moved from In Progress to Resolved on Sep 21, ten days before the real fix landed.
claims.quote: Status: In Progress → Resolved

claims.text: Priya Nair said the LUM-811 VAT export issue was being tracked for the 5.3.3 release, with the billing-v2 piece as separate work.
claims.quote: Also tracking in 5.3.3; the billing-v2 piece is separate. Confirm receipt.

claims.text: Nadia Chen told Bright Market the VAT rounding root cause from 5.3.0 was fixed properly in 5.3.4, in tomorrow's release.
claims.quote: Correct root found: the VAT rounding change in 5.3.0. Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow.

claims.text: Root cause: the KESTREL billing-v2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking export totals; the change went unreviewed.
claims.quote: Follow-up while triaging LUM-811: the KESTREL refactor (billing-v2) moved VAT rounding to integer math in 5.3.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the totals on export. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: Nadia Chen confirmed the correct root as the VAT rounding change introduced in 5.3.0, with the proper fix going into 5.3.4.
claims.quote: Correct root found: the VAT rounding change in 5.3.0. Fixed properly in 5.3.4 tomorrow.

claims.text: The blank VAT export totals first appeared with the 5.3.0 upgrade, as reported by Bright Market and logged in LUM-811 on Sep 2.
claims.quote: Received via finance call. Exports to the VAT format produce empty Total columns since the 5.3.0 upgrade.

claims.text: The ticket was resolved on Sep 21 claiming the fix landed with 5.3.3, before any finance-sandbox check confirmed it — the same day Sam Rivera re-ran the sandbox and found VAT exports still blank.
claims.quote: Resolved with the 5.3.3 rollout; exports verified on our side. Flagging as done.

claims.text: 5.3.3 did not fix the defect: a re-run against the finance sandbox showed VAT exports were still blank.
claims.quote: Re-ran finance sandbox: VAT exports are still blank. 5.3.3 did not fix it; reopening soon.

claims.text: The Sep 20 release (5.3.3) that shipped was announced as containing billing-v2 fixes across tenants, with no mention of a VAT export fix, and the ticket had already been closed on that basis.
claims.quote: Release 5.3.3 is live: includes billing-v2 fixes across tenants.

claims.text: The fix for the blank VAT totals actually landed in 5.3.4 on Sep 28, when the VAT rounding path was corrected and exports verified with finance — the ticket moved In Progress → Resolved that day.
claims.quote: Fixed in 5.3.4. VAT rounding path corrected; exports verified with finance.

claims.text: The ticket had to be reopened on Sep 26 after re-checking the finance sandbox showed totals still blank on VAT layouts, proving the earlier closure was wrong.
claims.quote: Reopened after re-checking the finance sandbox: totals still blank on VAT layouts.

claims.text: Ravi Menon promised Bright Market that the VAT export fix would ship in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: We have scheduled a fix for the Sep 20 release. Keeping LUM-811 updated.

claims.text: Ravi Menon publicly committed on Slack that the Bright Market export fix would ship in the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: For the Bright Market escalation (LUM-811): we will ship the export fix in the Sep 20 release.

claims.text: Bright Market's chases went unanswered: by Sep 23 Dana Okafor recorded a fourth follow-up since Sep 2 with no confirmation of the Sep 20 release.
claims.quote: Fourth follow-up since Sep 2. No confirmation on Sep 20.

claims.text: On Sep 22 the client chased in the general Slack channel for status on the VAT totals fix; the thread shows no reply from Lumen.
claims.quote: Dana Okafor here (Bright Market) — still nothing on the VAT totals fix?

claims.text: The client sent a second chase on Sep 22 (day six) and a third on Sep 23 threatening escalation to procurement; the records show no reply to either.
claims.quote: Second chase on the VAT invoice exports. Day six.

claims.text: By Sep 23 the client escalated to a third chase, warning it would escalate to procurement, with no reply recorded from Lumen.
claims.quote: Third chase. We escalate to procurement Monday if nothing moves.

claims.text: Coverage was thin during the failure window: Nadia Chen was on leave until the 25th and Ravi Menon took over KESTREL coverage.
claims.quote: Nadia Chen here: on leave until the 25th; Ravi Menon took over the KESTREL coverage.

claims.text: On Sep 4 the plan already conflated the billing-v2 work with the VAT export fix by tracking LUM-811 under 5.3.3 — the release that ultimately shipped only billing-v2 changes.
claims.quote: Also tracking in 5.3.3; the billing-v2 piece is separate. Confirm receipt.

claims.text: The client's escalation states totals were blank for four weeks since 5.3.0, that the promised Sep 20 fix was replaced by 5.3.3 announcements, the ticket was closed while their sandbox still showed blank exports, and their Sep 22–23 chases went unanswered.
claims.quote:
The totals have been blank since your 5.3.0 upgrade four weeks ago. We were told the fix
would ship in the Sep 20 release; instead your bot announced 5.3.3 fixes and the ticket was
closed while our finance sandbox still showed blank exports. Our chases on the 22nd and 23rd
went unanswered.

claims.text: On Sep 28 the client confirmed its imports were verified after the 5.3.4 fix, i.e. the totals were finally correct at that point.
claims.quote: Imports verified. Thank you — this took longer than it should have.

commitments.rationale: The Sep 20 release did not contain the fix; VAT exports were still blank afterwards and only 5.3.4 on Sep 28 resolved it.

commitments.rationale: LUM-811 was resolved on Sep 28 stating the VAT rounding path was corrected in 5.3.4 and exports verified with finance, and the client confirmed the imports verified.

issues.title: VAT export totals blank since 5.3.0
issues.ask: Explain what happened and when the blank VAT export totals were actually fixed.
issues.summary: Bright Market reports that VAT invoice export totals have been blank in their finance sandbox since the 5.3.0 upgrade, a promised Sep 20 fix did not materialize, and the ticket was closed as fixed in 5.3.3 before exports were verified.
